timingHacks.title: The Benagil Cave Timing Hack
timingHacks.description: Everyone goes mid-morning. The cave is packed 10am-4pm.
timingHacks.tip: Book a kayak tour that leaves at 7:30am (yes, they exist). You'll have the cave nearly to yourself, the light is better for photos, and the sea is calmer. Or go in November-March — the tours still run on good weather days, and you might be the only boat there.

timingHacks.title: Beach Parking Strategy
timingHacks.description: Beach parking lots fill by 10am in summer, then empty around 5pm when day-trippers leave.
timingHacks.tip: Arrive before 9am OR after 5pm for sunset sessions. If you're flexible, park once and beach-hop on foot using clifftop paths. Praia do Camilo to Ponta da Piedade is a beautiful walk.

timingHacks.title: Restaurant Reservation Sweet Spot
timingHacks.description: In summer, dinner reservations are hard to get for prime times (8-9pm).
timingHacks.tip: Book for 7pm or 9:30pm — both are usually available. 7pm gets you sunset views at coastal places; 9:30pm is when locals eat anyway. Or book lunch instead — same food, easier reservations, often with prix fixe deals.

timingHacks.title: Market Day Timing
timingHacks.description: Markets are busiest when tour buses arrive (10-11am).
timingHacks.tip: Loulé Saturday market: arrive at 8:30am for coffee, browse by 9am, leave by 10:30am before crowds peak. The fish section is best early when the catch is fresh. Same principle for Olhão and Tavira markets.

timingHacks.title: Sunset Viewing Strategy
timingHacks.description: Popular sunset spots (Cape St. Vincent, Ponta da Piedade) get crowded 30 minutes before sunset.
timingHacks.tip: Arrive 1.5 hours before sunset. Explore, take photos in golden hour light, find your spot, then stay as crowds arrive. You'll have the best position and great photos before others even park.
